protocol.description: Protocol to monitor. 'tcp', 'udp', or 'both'. Defaults to monitoring both if not specified.

interface.description: Network interface to monitor. 'all' monitors all except loopback.

use_bytes.description: View traffic in bytes instead of the default bits. Corresponds to the -B flag.

use_si_format.description: Use SI format (powers of 1000) instead of the default IEC format (powers of 1024). Corresponds to the --si flag.

color_scheme.description: Color scheme level (1, 2, or 3). 1 is the default. Corresponds to the --color flag.

numeric_mode.description: Show numeric host and service names without DNS/port translation. Corresponds to the -n flag.

verbose_mode.description: Enable verbose mode to show processes even if they have no traffic. Corresponds to the -v flag.

log_file.description: Path to the file where statistics summary will be saved. Corresponds to the -f flag.
